name: 3D-printed replacement wings for a hummingbird whirligig

mentions.name: 3D-printed replacement wings for a hummingbird whirligig
mentions.description: A 3D-printed repair project: custom replacement wings for a hummingbird whirligig yard decoration, modeled in Blender so a broken sentimental gift can be restored instead of thrown away.
mentions.problem: The hummingbird whirligig yard decoration broke a couple of years ago, and its sentimental value made throwing it away unappealing.
mentions.source_excerpt: Creating my own models in Blender for 3D printing. Currently creating replacement wings for a hummingbird whirligig yard decoration that broke a couple years ago. It’s a sentimental gift and I’ve hated the idea of throwing it away.
